def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marks = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v:
                marks[c-r] = v
    period = next(p for p in range(1, h+w+1)
                  if len({d % p for d in marks}) == p
                  and all(a % p != b % p or va == vb
                          for a, va in marks.items() for b, vb in marks.items()))
    palette = {d % period: v for d, v in marks.items()}
    return [[palette[(c-r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
